description.value: Pier 7 is a West Coast-inspired restaurant and bar perched on the revitalized Lower Lonsdale waterfront, offering 180-degree views of Vancouver's skyline, Lonsdale Quay, and the Shipyards District. The menu centres on fresh seafood, handcrafted cocktails, and seasonal dishes, with weekend brunch and a curated seafood tower as standout offerings. The restaurant sits next to St. Roch Dock, which can accommodate pleasure crafts up to 25 m, making it a rare spot reachable by both bike and boat.
